data.name: Illiyeen
data.gender_notes: Illiyeen is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: The One with Gentleness and Softness
data.long_meaning: The one who possesses gentle and soft qualities. Derived from the Arabic word 'il-lyan' which means 'gentle' or 'soft'. The name Illiyeen carries the meaning “The One with Gentleness and Softness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Illiyeen usually hope their child will grow to embody the one with gentleness and softness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Illiyeen is a name that evokes a sense of tranquility and calmness. It represents the gentle and soft side of nature, and those who bear this name are believed to possess these qualities as well. Illiyeen is a name that is often given to babies as a reminder of the importance of gentleness and compassion in the world.
data.etymology: Illiyeen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The One with Gentleness and Softness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Illiyeen total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_urdu.name: اليلین
in_urdu.meaning: وہ جو دل کو نرم دیتا ہے، جنگ میں نرم، اللہ کا حکم ماننے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: الیلین ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو عربي زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور اس کا مطلب ہے جو دل کو نرم دیتا ہے، جنگ میں نرم اور اللہ کا حکم ماننے والا، یہ نام ایک شخص کو بیان کرتا ہے جو اپنے اعمال میں اللہ کے حکم کی پیروی کرتا ہے اور کسی بھی صورت حال میں اپنا دل نرم رکھتا ہے، اس نام کو عام طور پر ایک سچے مسلم کو دیتے ہیں جو اللہ کی راہ میں ہر مشکل کو برداشت کرتا ہے

in_english.name: Illiyeen
in_english.meaning: one who is gentle to the heart, soft in battles, obedient to Allah
in_english.long_meaning: Illiyeen is an Arabic name that means one who is gentle to the heart, soft in battles, and obedient to Allah. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'lyy-n', which means to be gentle or soft. In the Islamic tradition, this name is associated with the qualities of patience, perseverance, and obedience to Allah. A person with this name is expected to be kind, compassionate, and gentle, even in the face of adversity. This name is also associated with the Arabic concept of 'sabr', which refers to the ability to endure difficulties with patience and resilience
